title.suggested: Death of Billy Bronson, Gallagher's Saloon Boxer

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported the death of boxer Billy Bronson, 38, who was always at Charley Gallagher's in the days when Tom Allen, McCoole and Gallagher made their headquarters in St. Louis.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Friday Morning, April 15, 1881, page 3. Pre-1888, so Missouri Republican, not St. Louis Republic.

facts.fact: Allen, Mike McCoole and Charley Gallagher at one time all made their headquarters in St. Louis

notes: Tag 'Legacy' is strictly for post-1903 retrospectives; this is a 1881 recollection, so tag choice could be revisited. Title suggested because Bronson did not 'recall' anything; it is his obituary.
